name: Mehujael
title: Descendant of Cain
summary: Mehujael was a descendant of Cain through Irad. He is mentioned in the genealogy of Cain in Genesis 4. He was the father of Methusael and thus part of the Cainite lineage that stood in contrast to the godly line of Seth.
relatedPersons: Lamech son of Methusael descendant of Cain

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Cain's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Mehujael is mentioned as the son of Irad and father of Methusael in the genealogy of Cain, which describes the Cainite line after Cain was exiled.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Cainite line
keyEvents.description: Mehujael belonged to the lineage from Cain that developed civilization but stood in opposition to the godly line from Seth.

keyEvents.title: Father of Methusael
keyEvents.description: Mehujael became the father of Methushael, who in turn became the father of Lamech—the first man to take two wives and known for his violent song of vengeance.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Lamech's lineage
keyEvents.description: Through his descendant Lamech, Mehujael became an ancestor of Jabal, Jubal, and Tubal-Cain, who were the founders of nomadic life, music, and metalworking.
